# Introduction

# Materials and Methods

## Reagents

```{r reagents-table}
reagents <- data.frame(
  Name = c(""),
  'Article Number' = c(""),
  Company = c(""),
  check.names = FALSE
)

kable(reagents, booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(1:3, width = "5.33cm")
```


## Buffers and Solutions

```{r buffers-table}
buffers <- data.frame(
  Name = c("Cryopreservation solution"),
  Composition = c("5% Me2SO (v/v), 0.1% sucrose (w/v)")
)

kable(buffers, booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "7cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "9cm")
```

## Tools and Devices

```{r tools-table}
tools <- data.frame(
  `Tool/Device` = c("High Pressure Freezer", "Automatic Freeze Substitution System", "MicroCT", "Ultramicrotome"),
  Model = c("HPM 010", "EM AFS II", "SkyScan 1272", "EM UC7" ),
  Company = c("BAL-TEC", "Leica", "Bruker", "Leica"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

kable(tools, booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(1:3, width = "5.33cm")
```
